MESSENGER BAG

The Léon messenger bag is both chic and casual, charming with its sleek, timeless design. Made from 590 g/m² British Millerain cotton twill and enhanced with vegetable-tanned leather inserts, it has a 7-liter capacity, so it can easily hold a 13-inch laptop while remaining compact enough to be carried throughout the day.

The highly functional bag has two exterior flap pockets for keeping essentials close at hand and a removable interior zippered cotton pocket dated and signed by the artisan who made it.
British Millerain cotton twill is renowned for its durability and weather resistance.

This high-quality fabric effectively protects your belongings while offering a refined texture and pleasant feel. The vegetable-tanned leather finishes and edging add a touch of elegance. The luxurious detail that makes all the difference is its elegant, refined Bleu de Chauffe personalized guilloché lock, which adds character and sophistication to the center of the bag.


Versatile by nature, the Léon bag goes well with both casual and formal outfits, making it the ideal companion for urban getaways.


Size: L 40 × H 27 × D 9 cm


Each piece is crafted in our workshop in Saint-Georges-de-Luzençon, France.


Made in France.

The Léon shoulder bag is made from 18Oz lick wax twill canvas by British Millerain. This 590 g/m² canvas stands out for its ultra-tight weave, which gives it remarkable resistance to abrasion and traction, making it a must-have for leather goods and luggage. The dry wax, applied meticulously, provides a non-greasy feel and optimal protection against the elements, ensuring durability and comfort in urban environments.


- 18 oz. lick wax twill cotton canvas

- Vegetable-tanned leather inserts and trim

- Tuck lock clasp

- Adjustable shoulder strap

- Two front pockets under flap

- Removable interior zippered cotton pocket dated and signed by the artisan who made the bag

- Bleu de Chauffe label

-External dimensions: W 40 x H 27 x D 9 cm

-Internal dimensions of main compartment: W 39 x H 26 x D 8 cm (fits laptops up to 13 inches)

-The two front pockets measure: W 16 cm x H 20 cm

We recommend measuring your laptop to check compatibility.

Shoulder strap dimensions:

Adjustable length: from 67 cm to 125 cm

Width: 4 cm

The strap is designed to be incredibly versatile: with its adjustable length, you can decide whether you want to carry it over the shoulder or across the chest. It is 4 cm wide, ensuring the weight is spread evenly and guaranteeing optimal comfort even when worn for an extended period.

Men’s messenger bags – what’s the occasion?

Multifunctionality is certainly the watchword when it comes to the men’s messenger bag. With its modest size, it can be carried just as easily in the hand or over the shoulder. This makes it a great bag for many different occasions and means you can carry a whole range of items: papers, laptops, smaller articles, folders – it is therefore perfect for both professionals and students. It is also very practical for short trips or one or two-night stays. For longer trips a travel bag would be a better choice. The men’s musette is ideal for the day-to-day, for short or medium-length trips, and when travelling for work.

How to choose the right men’s musette?

Bleu de Chauffe has two main lines in the men’s musette: cotton canvas bags and vegetable-tanned leather bags. The leather version is distinguished by its classic look, whereas the canvas version is more contemporary. The bag’s volume (around 7 liters) means you can carry a whole range of items, although it is especially designed for laptops and files. It is easy to open and close, giving you quick access to the contents of your bag. The strap is completely adjustable so you can carry your bag close to the body or more loosely depending on your own personal style. Explore our messenger bags in a range of shades: Blue, green, chestnut brown, black, and many more – find them all on the Bleu de Chauffe website !

What are the distinctive features of the Men’s Messenger bag from Bleu de Chauffe?

The Men’s Messenger bag is one of our flagship models – quintessential Bleu de Chauffe. Practical and hard-wearing, it is a “bag for life”. It is perfect for all kinds of travel thanks to its lightweight design and large capacity. Inspired by traditional work bags, Bleu de Chauffe products are manufactured with respect for the people who make the bags and the environment around us. Our workshop is based in Saint Georges de Luzencon, and this is how we work: every Messenger satchel is made in France by a single artisan leathersmith.

How Does the Messenger Bag Stand Out with Its Versatility?

The men's messenger bag, beyond its practical design, excels in its ability to transport various accessories. Its compartmentalized structure allows for intelligent organization of items, making it easy to quickly access everything you need: phone, tablet, laptop, documents, pens, and more. Unlike traditional bags, which are often disorganized, the messenger bag is designed to meet modern demands: a dedicated laptop pocket, specific slots for everyday small items like pens, notebooks, or smartphones, and secure closures to keep everything well protected. Each compartment is designed for optimized use, allowing you to keep your belongings neatly arranged even during busy days. This type of men's bag adapts perfectly to the diversity of urban environments thanks to its versatility. In addition to its lightweight design, it offers a high level of comfort whether you’re walking, biking, or using public transport. Its flat shape makes it a discreet travel companion, avoiding the bulk of larger bags while maximizing storage space. Whether for short trips or longer journeys, the leather messenger bag excels in its ability to carry essentials without being cumbersome. Moreover, the messenger bag is a timeless fashion accessory that fits seamlessly into various styles. Whether you choose a casual or more professional outfit, its understated and elegant appearance makes it versatile for all occasions. Its minimalist design, combined with durable materials, makes it a choice that is both aesthetic and practical, ensuring a long lifespan without compromising on style. It thus becomes a must-have for the modern man who seeks a balance between functionality and elegance.

How to Wear the Messenger Bag from Bleu de Chauffe?

Resolutely urban, the leather messenger bag for men from Bleu de Chauffe can be worn in various ways. In a professional context, you can carry it by hand, thanks to its sturdy handle that allows for transporting documents or laptops. The buckle closure ensures that your belongings are well secured. Most of the leather briefcases from Bleu de Chauffe feature a strap, allowing you to wear it crossbody for a more modern and urban look. It can also be worn over one shoulder. Due to its durability and longevity, Bleu de Chauffe bags will accompany you equally well during your studies and in the professional world. For quick access to your documents, the opening of the leather bags from the brand is quick, particularly thanks to a snap button closure.

In which situations should you use a men's messenger bag?

The men's messenger bag is perfect for carrying documents, laptops, and daily essentials, whether for work, study, or short trips.

What criteria should you consider when choosing a men's messenger bag?

Choose quality leather or durable canvas, a suitable capacity (around 7 liters), and an adjustable shoulder strap for comfortable wear.

What are the unique features of the Bleu de Chauffe messenger bag?

Handmade in France, it combines sleek design, durability, and interior organization designed for everyday use.

Why is the messenger bag so versatile?

Its compartmentalized structure makes organizing laptops, phones, papers, and accessories easy, with optimal comfort in all situations.

How to wear a Bleu de Chauffe messenger bag?

Carry it by hand, crossbody, or over the shoulder; it adapts to all styles and lifestyles, ensuring practicality and elegance.
